  SELECT reel_id, mark_kind, score_id, span_sec,
         SUM(CASE WHEN mark_kind IN ('play', 'clear') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY reel_id ORDER BY seq_no ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS segment_no
  FROM reel_mark
), resolved AS (
  SELECT mark_kind, span_sec,
         MAX(CASE WHEN mark_kind = 'play' THEN score_id END) OVER (PARTITION BY reel_id, segment_no) AS active_score
  FROM segments
)
SELECT active_score AS score_id, SUM(span_sec) AS performed_sec, COUNT(*) AS cue_count

GROUP BY active_score COLLATE BINARY
ORDER BY performed_sec DESC, score_id COLLATE BINARY ASC;",
  "decision-recover-signatures-from-conjugate-leaves": "WITH ranked AS (

         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.target_id ORDER BY s.inspection_no DESC, s.source_id COLLATE BINARY ASC) AS evidence_rank
  FROM rubbed_leaf AS t
  LEFT JOIN inspection_slip AS s
    ON s.copy_code = t.copy_code
   AND s.gathering_no = t.gathering_no
   AND s.leaf_pos = t.leaf_count + 1 - t.leaf_pos
   AND s.intact = 1
   AND s.signature IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT target_id, signature, source_id

  "decision-refill-meter-csv": "WITH records AS (

  FROM refill_tick AS e
  JOIN refill_tick AS p ON p.tick_no = e.tick_no - 1
  WHERE e.dial_litres IS NOT NULL AND p.dial_litres IS NOT NULL

  "decision-regional-capacity-commitment-under-cash-cap": "WITH priced AS (
  SELECT o.region_code, o.offer_code, o.fee_cents,
         o.fee_cents + MAX(0, f.demand_units - o.included_units) * f.overage_cents AS period_cents
  FROM capacity_offer AS o
  JOIN region_forecast AS f ON f.region_code = o.region_code
)
SELECT e.offer_code AS east_offer, w.offer_code AS west_offer,
       e.fee_cents + w.fee_cents AS upfront_cents,
       e.period_cents + w.period_cents AS total_cents

WITH segments AS (
  SELECT reel_id, mark_kind, score_id, span_sec,
         SUM(CASE WHEN mark_kind IN ('play', 'clear') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY reel_id ORDER BY seq_no ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS segment_no
  FROM reel_mark
), resolved AS (
  SELECT mark_kind, span_sec,
         MAX(CASE WHEN mark_kind = 'play' THEN score_id END) OVER (PARTITION BY reel_id, segment_no) AS active_score
  FROM segments
)
SELECT active_score AS score_id, SUM(span_sec) AS performed_sec, COUNT(*) AS cue_count
FROM resolved
WHERE mark_kind IN ('play', 'reprise') AND active_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY active_score COLLATE BINARY
ORDER BY performed_sec DESC, score_id COLLATE BINARY ASC;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT t.target_id, s.signature, s.source_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.target_id ORDER BY s.inspection_no DESC, s.source_id COLLATE BINARY ASC) AS evidence_rank
  FROM rubbed_leaf AS t
  LEFT JOIN inspection_slip AS s
    ON s.copy_code = t.copy_code
   AND s.gathering_no = t.gathering_no
   AND s.leaf_pos = t.leaf_count + 1 - t.leaf_pos
   AND s.intact = 1
   AND s.signature IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT target_id, signature, source_id
FROM ranked
WHERE evidence_rank = 1
ORDER BY target_id ASC;
